summary: Shutterstock filed an 8-K reporting that Getty Images terminated the previously announced merger agreement after the UK CMA required sale of Shutterstock's editorial business. Getty's board resolved not to proceed with the divestiture and to terminate the agreement after the extended end date of July 6, 2026. No deal terms (price, premium) are restated. The CMA regulatory condition proved insurmountable. Shutterstock CEO stated the company will continue as standalone. Risk-arb: previous transaction now dead; watch for any reverse break fee or litigation.
